constructionNotes: A single closed faceted quatrefoil supplies the outer loop. Four smaller pointed compartments follow its lobes and one inner cord follows the actual upright guide. It is an ornamental loop study, not a topological knot assertion.
limits: Finite native chords, shared prototypes and actual landmark-offset witnesses; no analytic curvature, occupied-face clearance, automatic physical join from coordinate equality, learned beauty, or hidden over/under continuity is claimed.
